title: Modern Maths
tagline: P&C and probability — counting carefully beats formula-hunting.

subsections.title: Permutations & Combinations
subsections.trick: Ask ‘does order matter?’ before picking P or C — arrangements/rankings/passwords = P, selections/groups/committees = C. For circular arrangements, it's (n−1)!, not n! — fixing one position removes the rotational duplicates.

subsections.title: Probability
subsections.trick: Mutually exclusive vs independent are different conditions — don't apply P(E)+P(F) when you actually need P(E)×P(F). Complement rule (1−P(E)) is usually faster than direct counting for ‘at least one’ questions.

formulas.label: Mutually exclusive events
formulas.latex: P(A\cap B) = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; P(A \text{ or } B) = P(A)+P(B)
